application.why_mentor: I was a first-generation college student who had no idea how the tech industry actually worked. I spent three years making avoidable mistakes that a good mentor could have helped me skip. I mentor now because I want to be the person I needed at 22.
application.previous_experience: Mentored 6 engineers over the past 3 years informally through my company's internal program.
application.expectations: A mentee who shows up prepared, follows through on commitments, and is honest about where they are struggling.
application.additional_context: I am a first-generation Korean-American. I understand the specific pressures that come with being the first in your family to navigate corporate America.
